subject: Application for Senior Python Developer (Pune) - Ref NX-DEV-1142
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Senior Python Developer position (Ref NX-DEV-1142) at your Pune office, which I found on your careers page. I have six years of experience building backend systems in Django and FastAPI, and for the last two years I have been leading a team of four engineers at a fintech company in Baner.

In my current role I redesigned our payment reconciliation service, bringing processing time down from 40 minutes to under 6, and I have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and AWS. body:
To the Recruitment Team,

This is my fourth email on this. I completed all three interview rounds between 1 and 9 September and on 28 September Ms. Pallavi told me on the phone that I had been selected and that the offer letter would be sent in 2-3 days. It is 22 October, and I have still received nothing. Every time I call, I am told that 'it is with the approvals'.

Based on that verbal confirmation I gave my resignation at my current company on 5 October and my last day there is 4 November. If this offer is not coming through, then I should have been informed immediately. This is extremely unprofessional and I am seriously upset about how this process has been handled.

I expect a written response with the offer letter, or a clear explanation of the delay, by tomorrow evening.

Rakesh Dubey
